XO-Hugbox

Prototype
To install on iPhone: Share, then Add to Home Screen.
The device's own C++ (firmware/lib/hugbox_core) compiled to WebAssembly with the real U8g2 SH1106 driver: 6-voice synth, 16-pad sampler, sequencer, FX, projects and MIDI, exactly as the board runs them.

OLED · 128×64 SH1106, as the player sees it

Hugbox guide

Knobs are numbered 1-4 from the left. Pads are named by their keyboard key: the top row is 1234, then Q-R, A-F, Z-V. Shift is the orange key (or your Shift key).

Knobs right now
Power on to see the live knob map.

Updates as you move around. Red rows need Shift held while turning.

How do I…?

Turn on chord mode

  1. Shift + S (SYN) picks the synth track and its PLAY screen.
  2. Hold Shift and turn knob 3 (CHRD): 5TH, TRIAD, 7TH, SUS2 or SUS4.
  3. Play pads: each one now plays a chord built from the current scale. Sequencer steps play chords too.
  4. Inversions: Shift + 3 (SND) until the title reads CHORD/ARP, then knob 2 (INV).

Turn on the arpeggiator

  1. On the synth PLAY screen, hold Shift and turn knob 4 (ARP): UP, DOWN, UP/DN, RAND or ORDER.
  2. Hold one or more pads; the arp plays their notes (with chord mode on, it plays the chord's notes).
  3. Speed, octaves, gate and latch are on SOUND page CHORD/ARP: Shift + 3 until you see it. RATE 1/4…1/32 incl. triplets, OCTS 1-3, AGAT note length, LTCH ON keeps it running after you let go.

Make a drum beat

  1. Shift + A (SAMPLER track), then Shift + 2 (SEQ).
  2. Knob 1 (PAD) chooses which drum you're writing for: KCK, SNR, CHH…
  3. Tap pads to switch steps on/off (top-left = step 1, reading like text).
  4. Shift + D (RUN) starts and stops it. Pick another drum with knob 1 and add its steps.

Record by playing

  1. Shift + F (REC) arms recording (red dot on the top line), Shift + D (RUN) starts.
  2. Go to PLAY (Shift + 1) and play pads: each hit is written to the nearest step.

Tweak a single step

  1. In SEQ, hold a step pad and turn a knob: 1 VEL, 2 NOTE, 3 GATE (length), 4 PROB (chance it plays).

Change tempo, swing or pattern length

  • In SEQ: knob 2 BPM, knob 3 SWNG, knob 4 LEN (16, 32, 48 or 64 steps). Pages 1-4: Shift + Q W E R.

Change scale, key or octave

  • Synth PLAY screen, hold Shift: knob 1 OCT, knob 2 SCAL (CHROM, MAJOR, MINOR, PENTA, DORIAN). Root note: CHORD/ARP page, Shift + knob 4 ROOT.

Shape the synth sound

  • Shift + 3 (SND) cycles OSC (waves, detune, mix, FM, drift, glide) → FILTER (cutoff, resonance, envelope, volume, ADSR) → CHORD/ARP.

Change a drum sound

  • On the sampler track, tap the pad, then Shift + 3 (SND): PTCH DCY CUT LVL, with Shift SMPL PAN CHOK KIT.

Add delay, drive or lo-fi

  • Shift + 4 (FX): knob 3 DLY (amount), 1 TIME (1/32…1/2, synced), 2 FDBK, 4 DRV; with Shift CRSH (bits), LOFI, LCUT (low cut), MVOL.

Record a sample

  1. Click Use mic (Mic · samples, below). On the Hugbox, the mic is the small hole marked MIC.
  2. Shift + hold F (REC) for 1 s, then let go: SAMPLE opens on READY with an input meter. (A quick tap is still sequencer record.) Knobs: GAIN, THRS (wait for the sound to start), MON (hear the mic), SRC.
  3. Any pad starts it: a beep, then recording. Hold the pad and let go to stop, or tap it and tap any pad again to stop (hands free). Up to 20 s.
  4. The take is trimmed to the sound, plays once and opens in the editor (below).
  5. Shift + F (REC): SAVE TO PAD? Tap the pad it goes on: it plays and shows U01…U16 on every screen. A pad that already has a recording asks for a second tap; Shift goes back to trimming.
  6. Leave with Shift + any view: the samples are saved (a take you didn't save is dropped).

Trim a sample

  • The editor is XOXO Studio's: knobs 1 STRT, 2 END (the two markers), 3 FDIN, 4 FDOU (fades); with Shift NORM (to -6 dB), REV (reverse) and knob 4 SRC. Every change plays the result; tap any pad to hear it again, hold a pad 0.6 s for a new take.
  • To edit a sample already on a pad: on READY turn SRC to it (U01…; turn it fully left first so the knob picks up), trim, then save it back, or onto another pad for a copy.
  • To give a pad its built-in sound back: SRC to that kit sound (KCK…), and save it onto its pad untouched.
  • Pitch, decay and filter are the pad's usual SOUND knobs.

Save or load a project

  1. Shift + V (SET). The top two pad rows are slots S1-S8 (filled = has a project).
  2. Hold a slot pad until the bar fills to save into it; tap a slot to load it.
  3. You never lose work by switching off: everything autosaves a few seconds after each change.

Copy a page, clear, mute, tap tempo

  • On the SETTINGS pads: CPY copies the current sequencer page of the current track, PST pastes it onto the page you're on (pick pages with Shift + Q-R), CLR clears the page, CLT (hold) clears the whole track.
  • MDR / MSY mute the sampler / synth sequence (live pads still play).
  • TAP 3-4 times in time sets the tempo. PNC stops every stuck note (MIDI panic).

Play other gear over MIDI

  1. Shift + C (LAYERED) plays the Hugbox and sends MIDI; Shift + X (CONTROLLER) sends MIDI only.
  2. Synth notes go out on MCH, the sampler track on SCH (10, GM drum notes): SETTINGS knobs 1-2. The sequencer, arp and clock go out too.
  3. In Controller mode the knobs send CC 70-73 (Shift: 74-77) instead of changing sounds.
  4. Over Bluetooth: BLE ON (SETTINGS knob 4), then pair "XO-Hugbox" in your app.

Sync to a DAW or another box

  • SETTINGS knob 3 SYNC: INT = Hugbox is the clock; USB / BLE = follow incoming clock and start/stop (tempo shows on the screen; RUN is then controlled from outside).

Get back to where I was

  • Double-tap Shift to see every shortcut on the screen, then tap the pad you want.
Shortcut map (Shift + pad)
1PLAY2SEQ3SOUND4FX QPAGE 1WPAGE 2EPAGE 3RPAGE 4 ASAMPLERSSYNTHDRUN/STOPFREC · hold: SAMPLE ZSTANDALONEXCONTROLLERCLAYEREDVSETTINGS
  • Hold Shift: the knobs switch to their second four (the bottom line of the screen turns inverted). The screen stays put.
  • Double-tap Shift: this map appears on the OLED; tap any pad to run its shortcut. Shift, a knob or 5 s closes it.
  • SOUND pressed again cycles the synth pages. Choosing SAMPLER/SYNTH from FX, SETTINGS or SAMPLE jumps to that track's PLAY screen.
Reading the screen
  • Top line: mode box (STD/CTL/LAY) · track · tempo · sequencer page shown (P1) · ▶ running / ■ stopped · ● record armed (blinks while recording) · BT Bluetooth on · battery.
  • Bottom line: what knobs 1-4 do; inverted while Shift is held. The small bar under each shows its value.
  • Turning a knob pops up its full name and value. < TURN / TURN > means the knob hasn't reached the stored value yet: turn it that way until it catches (so values never jump).
  • Pad grid: PLAY shows pad names (kit sounds, or U01-U16 for recordings) or note names (root notes underlined, last-hit pad underlined). SEQ shows steps: filled = on, small block = playhead, dot = beyond the pattern length.
The views
  • PLAY: sampler: 16 sounds (the kit or your recordings), bottom-left is the kick. Synth: notes of the scale, bottom-left is the root, rising left→right, bottom→top.
  • SEQ: 16 steps per page, 4 pages. Sampler steps belong to the pad chosen with knob 1; synth steps play scale notes.
  • SOUND: sampler: the selected pad's sound. Synth: OSC, FILTER and CHORD/ARP pages.
  • FX: master delay, drive, bitcrush, lo-fi, low cut and volume.
  • SETTINGS: pads = projects (S1-S8), page copy/paste/clear, track mutes, tap tempo, panic. Knobs: synth MIDI channel, sampler MIDI channel, clock source, Bluetooth; Shift: screen brightness.
  • SAMPLE (Shift + hold REC 1 s): READY (record) → trim → SAVE TO PAD?. Filled pads hold a recording.

Monitor level only scales your computer's output; the device's own volume is a knob parameter (MVOL, or pot 0 in the bring-up test).

Mic · samples

The board's INMP441 mic listens through the small hole marked MIC between the keys and the knobs. Here your computer's mic stands in for it (turned down 20 dB, about as sensitive as the INMP441). Shift + hold F (REC) 1 s opens SAMPLE; tap or hold any pad to record (a beep first), trim it, then Shift + F and tap the pad to save it to. Use headphones if you turn the monitor on.

Keyboard

      
Hold Shift for the second set of knob parameters (the screen stays put); Shift + pad runs the orange shortcut.
        Double-tap Shift to show the shortcut map, then tap any pad to run it (Shift tap, a knob or 5 s closes it).
        Knobs only take over a value once you turn them past it (the readout shows TURN until then).
        In SEQ, tap a pad to toggle a step; hold a step and turn a knob to set its velocity / pitch / gate / probability.
        Synth track: chords and the arpeggiator are on SOUND page 3 (Shift + SND until it shows CHORD/ARP), or on the PLAY view's shift knobs.
        Shift + hold F (REC) 1 s opens SAMPLE: tap or hold a pad to record, trim, Shift + F to save it to a pad.

      
Pad n = C4 + n semitones (pad 0 = C4 top-left … pad 15 = D#5). Lowest held pad wins. Shift + pad = 1 kHz.
